newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel nearly $3 higher, demand poor.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel nearly $3 higher, demand poor.

text.p: European jet fuel bounced higher on Tuesday as sharp gains on IPE gas oil futures pulled outright prices upwards.
May IPE was trading $2.75 a tonne stronger at $168.50 around 1540 GMT taking support from firmer NYMEX heating oil and stronger crude.
Traders said activity was slow with the stronger numbers putting off unpressured buyers. Barge premiums were heard around May IPE +$18.50 fob AR, but the market was almost non-existant.
Cargo premiums were seen to have eased $1 or so at May IPE +$23 cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean difficulty in finding affordable freight has compounded traders problems of thin market demand.
"Most of the requirement is for small quantities and its hard to do much with high freight," traders said.
Sellers of EU spec were holding for high fob quotes +$8 against potential buying interest around fob high quotes +$6.

Libyan material has gone long with only one 7,000 tonne requirement seen. Combined with a non-workable arb traders said buyers were down at high fob +$3, although sellers were looking for high fob +$6.
